_source: Placement library (1/N). Vimshottari mahadasha impact, keyed by the ruling planet (DASHA_LORDS in astrology.service.ts). Consumed by InterpretationService for the `dasha` domain so it returns a KB-assembled reading instead of calling the LLM. Payload mirrors InterpretationResult. English-authored; run `npm run kb:backfill -- --tables=dasha-impacts` to fill the other 11 locales (until then non-English requests fall through to the localized LLM path via renderStatus().matched).
_shape: { summary: string, points: string[], guidance: string }

en.summary: You're in your Sun period — a chapter that pushes you toward visibility, confidence, and standing on your own. It's a time to step into leadership and let your real self be seen.
points: Recognition and authority tend to grow now — good for career moves, leadership roles, and being noticed for your work.
Your confidence and willpower are stronger, so decisions and bold action come more easily.
Themes around father figures, mentors, and official or government matters often come into focus.
Watch a tendency toward ego or stubbornness — your strength lands better when it stays humble.
en.guidance: Take the lead on something that matters to you and let your work speak for itself. Honest self-respect, good routines, and a little daily sunlight all support this period.

en.summary: You're in your Moon period — an emotionally rich chapter centred on home, feelings, and your inner world. Life moves with your moods, and caring connections matter most.
points: Emotional sensitivity and intuition run high — trust your gut and protect your peace of mind.
Home, family, and nurturing figures (especially your mother) often take centre stage.
Your public image and likeability can rise; people warm to you more easily.
Moods may swing — gentle, regular routines steady you when things feel changeable.
en.guidance: Tend to your home and emotional health as the foundation of everything else right now. Rest, calm surroundings, and time with people who comfort you go a long way.

en.summary: You're in your Mars period — a high-energy chapter of drive, courage, and getting things done. It's a time to act on your ambitions and build something through your own effort.
points: Energy, courage, and determination are strong — great for starting projects, sport, and bold moves.
Property, land, and matters involving siblings often come up.
You can finally push through obstacles that stalled you before.
Channel the heat: impatience or conflict can flare, so aim the drive at goals rather than people.
en.guidance: Pick a meaningful challenge and pour your energy into it. Regular exercise and a clear plan keep Mars's fire productive instead of restless.

en.summary: You're in your Mercury period — a sharp, communicative chapter that favours learning, business, and connection. Your mind is quick and curious now.
points: Communication, writing, and negotiation flow well — strong for business, study, and networking.
Picking up new skills and adapting to change comes more easily.
Commerce, trade, and analytical work are well supported.
So many ideas can scatter your focus — finishing what you start is the real win.
en.guidance: Put your words and ideas to work: write, pitch, learn, connect. A simple system to capture and complete tasks turns Mercury's speed into results.

en.summary: You're in your Jupiter period — one of the most fortunate chapters, bringing growth, wisdom, and expansion. Doors tend to open and life feels more abundant.
points: Growth and good fortune are favoured — in finances, knowledge, and opportunities.
Wisdom, teaching, mentorship, and spiritual interests deepen.
Themes of children, family expansion, and higher learning often arise.
Abundance can tip into over-optimism or overindulgence — stay grounded as you grow.
en.guidance: Say yes to growth: learn, teach, invest in yourself, and be generous. Keep your commitments realistic so the expansion stays healthy.

en.summary: You're in your Venus period — the longest and most pleasurable chapter, centred on love, beauty, comfort, and relationships. Life leans toward harmony and enjoyment.
points: Love, marriage, and partnerships are strongly favoured.
Comfort, beauty, the arts, and material ease tend to increase.
Creativity and a taste for the finer things flourish.
Too much comfort can soften your edge — balance pleasure with purpose.
en.guidance: Invest in your relationships and in the beauty around you, while keeping one foot in your goals. Creative pursuits and genuine connection are deeply nourishing now.

en.summary: You're in your Saturn period — a serious, maturing chapter that rewards patience and honest effort. It can feel demanding, but it builds lasting foundations.
points: Discipline, responsibility, and steady work are the themes — slow progress beats shortcuts.
Early delays or tests often give way to durable rewards if you persevere.
Career and long-term structures get built or rebuilt now.
Don't read difficulty as failure — Saturn is teaching, not punishing.
en.guidance: Commit to the long game: show up consistently, honour your duties, and let results compound. Rest, simplicity, and patience are your allies through this period.

en.summary: You're in your Rahu period — an intense, ambitious chapter of big desires, sudden changes, and unconventional paths. Life can move fast and in surprising directions.
points: Worldly ambition runs high — strong for unconventional careers, technology, and foreign connections.
Sudden opportunities and rapid changes are common; staying adaptable helps.
You may be drawn to the new, the bold, or the unfamiliar.
Watch for restlessness, obsession, or chasing illusions — keep your feet on the ground.
en.guidance: Aim your ambition at something real and let it stretch you, but verify before you leap. Grounding habits and honest advisors keep Rahu's energy from running away with you.

en.summary: You're in your Ketu period — an inward, spiritual chapter about letting go, introspection, and finding meaning beyond the material. It can feel quieter and more reflective.
points: Detachment grows — interests turn toward spirituality, research, and the inner life.
You may feel pulled to release things, people, or patterns you've outgrown.
Intuition and depth increase; surface ambitions matter less.
Sudden shifts or a sense of confusion can arise — anchor yourself in practice and patience.
en.guidance: Make space for stillness: meditation, study, or solitude pay off now. Trust that what falls away is making room for something more essential.
